NBA DFS Picks for Tuesday, October 27 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, October 27 · 4 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 27, 7:27 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) is the top-projected player on the Tuesday, October 27 DraftKings main slate at 58.1 DraftKings points for $11,300. Victor Wembanyama (SAS, 54.9, $10,800) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.9, $9,500) are next.

Paul Reed (DET) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.00 projected points per $1,000 at $5,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 27, 7:27 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
